ticket.title: Add CSV export to the reports page
ticket.description: Finance copies report rows by hand every Monday.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Export downloads a CSV containing every currently visible row.
The CSV includes a header row and opens without errors in a spreadsheet.

ticket.title: Improve the dashboard
ticket.description: Make the dashboard nicer to use.
acceptanceCriteria: The dashboard should feel faster and look better.

ticket.title: Fix expired-session redirect
ticket.description: Users are sent to the login page and then stranded there.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an expired session, signing in returns the user to the page they originally requested.

ticket.title: Update onboarding copy
ticket.description: The copy changes are tracked elsewhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Matches the requirements described in the attached spec.

ticket.title: Refactor the settings module
acceptanceCriteria: Code works as expected and handles errors gracefully.

ticket.title: Rate-limit password reset
ticket.description: Reduce abuse of the reset endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: A fifth password-reset request from the same account within ten minutes returns HTTP 429 and sends no email.

ticket.title: Add SSO login
acceptanceCriteria: Passes QA and meets the agreed requirements.
